lean.statement:
theorem IsLocalMax.deriv_deriv_nonpos_of_continuousAt
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℝ} (hmax : IsLocalMax f x)
    (hc : ContinuousAt f x) :
    deriv (deriv f) x ≤ 0
approved_definition_context: IsLocalMax f x means f(y) is no larger than f(x) for all y in some neighborhood of x.
ContinuousAt f x is continuity at the extremum.
Mathlib deriv is total; the theorem does not claim a separate classical second derivative exists.
